get.description:
Pairs of a buyer and a supplier with repeated accepted direct purchases just under the
legal limit of their contract type, most purchases first.

A purchase is near the limit from `rule.share` of it to just under it. A purchase whose type is
not known cannot be checked: `checked` of `accepted_total` were, and `first_day` and
`last_day` bound those. As csv: every pair, one line per purchase.

Every contract of one notice, whatever its date, in SEAP's order of signing.

Framework agreements are left out: their value is a ceiling, and what is committed
under them are their subsequent contracts, which are listed. The list is not complete:
SEAP publishes many contracts weeks after they are signed.

post.description:
Tell us that something on a page is wrong. A person reads it before anything changes.

A reader may send a few reports an hour. The site passes the reader's address on in
`X-Forwarded-For`; a call made straight to the API counts under the caller's own.

members in and out of it is counted apart, and no member stands for it.
